Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 exercise anatomy illustration, the SETUP master for a kneeling cable crunch. Reference image is athlete identity/style only. Fixed near-side three-quarter camera, enough frontal view that both separate hands and bent arms are readable. Shins and both knees on mat, hips set slightly back and stationary, torso nearly upright with slight natural flexion, neck neutral. Both hands firmly grip the two ends of a black rope beside the temples, elbows bent pointing down-forward. Exactly eight equal thin dark steel plates; top ONE selected plate is just slightly lifted with a narrow visible gap above seven resting plates. No extra pulleys, spare cable branches or handles. Machine on RIGHT separate from athlete; uncluttered. The cable is one unbroken taut line from rope connector over pulley to centre of top plate, visibly attached, not intersecting head or body. Full machine stable and rigid. Clean instructional illustration with anatomically plausible knees/hips/arms and readable grip ownership. No theatrical lighting or ground vignette.
